description:
Hi, I'm Hank Mercer, a retired service tech, and I show you what's actually wrong in your house before somebody quotes you for it.

Whether you're standing over a machine that won't start or you're just tired of paying a minimum call-out for eleven minutes of work, you're in the right place. For nineteen years I ran a service van into other people's basements, laundry rooms and crawl spaces, for the same companies I now talk about — so I know what a three dollar tool looks like on a two hundred and eighty-five dollar invoice.

Here you'll learn what really goes wrong behind the panel — the drain trap, the door seal, the pump filter — how to handle it for a fraction of the bill, and how to tell a repair you need from one you're being sold. No scare tactics, no upsells, and I'll always tell you plainly when to put the tools down and call somebody.

Subscribe if you'd rather know what's wrong than take their word for it.
